originalEntry.title: SaaS launch video for a product Opus picks
originalEntry.title_zh: 自选 SaaS 的产品发布视频
originalEntry.author: moritzkremb
originalEntry.description: A 46-second SaaS launch video where Opus picks a well-known product, pulls real assets from the web and edits a features-and-benefits promo, built with HyperFrames.
originalEntry.description_zh: Opus 自己挑一个知名 SaaS，从网上找真实素材，剪出 46 秒的发布视频，用 HyperFrames 做成。
originalEntry.prompt: I want you to create a highly professional SaaS product launch video. Go and find some SaaS, preferably just one that people know, so it's easier to identify with it. Pick that, and then make sure to get actual assets and images and all of that stuff from the internet. Turn it into these typical, very professionally edited, motion-graphics-styled product launch videos that you see people making on Twitter when they launch new SaaS products (which are showing off the features, the benefits, and all of these things).
originalEntry.prompt_zh: 我希望你做一支非常专业的 SaaS 产品发布视频。去找一个 SaaS，最好是大家都知道的，这样更容易有代入感。选定它，然后一定要从网上拿到真实的素材、图片之类的东西。把它做成那种典型的、剪辑非常专业的动态图形风格产品发布视频，就是大家在 Twitter 上发布新 SaaS 产品时做的那种（展示功能、好处等等）。
